---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement aligned with the project direction
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary / 功能概述

Describe the feature you want.

请描述你希望增加的功能。

## Problem it solves / 解决什么问题

What problem does this feature solve?

这个功能解决什么问题？

## Proposed approach / 建议方案

How do you think it should work?

你认为它应该如何工作？

## Scope check / 范围检查

Please confirm the request does not turn the project into:

请确认这个需求不会把项目引向以下方向：

- Cloud dependency / 云依赖
- Account system / 账号系统
- Medical judgment system / 医疗判断系统

## Hardware impact / 硬件影响

Does this require new hardware, PCB changes, or different wiring?

这个功能是否需要新增硬件、修改 PCB 或改变接线？

## Extra notes / 额外说明

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.

任何有助于评估该需求的信息都可以写在这里。
